baseline.actual: Current policy/scanner/test hashes are preserved in rollback-baseline.sha256; C1E behavior not yet executed.

criteria.conditions: Only the three approved code/config/test paths may change; approved gate and preview remain immutable.
criteria.evidence_method: Inspect the full diff and pre/post hashes; compare the changed files to the approved preview and task registration.
criteria.source: User-approved C1E gate and preview; A24-03-C1E task contract.
criteria.target: Only config/workspace-dependency-policy.json, scripts/workspace-dependency-audit.mjs, and tests/workspace-dependency-audit.test.js are edited; the C1 fixture and historical evidence remain byte-stable.
criteria.validity_notes: A diff or hash of any additional product path rejects this criterion.

baseline.actual: Policy binds npm to M07-S1-R1/npm-version.txt; scanner accepts M07-BUILD-S1 and M07-S1-R1 only.

criteria.conditions: Candidate output stays under the repository evidence root with traversal and symlink checks intact.
criteria.evidence_method: Inspect implementation and run scanner tests for exact C1E positive, unapproved-name negative, historical allowlist, traversal, and symlink escape cases.
criteria.source: Approved C1E preview; existing scanner path validation contract.
criteria.target: Exactly M07-S1-R1-C1E is newly allowed and exactly its npm-version.txt is candidate-bound; arbitrary names, traversal, and symlink escapes remain rejected.
criteria.validity_notes: Both the positive path and rejection cases must execute; source inspection alone cannot satisfy the test criterion.

baseline.actual: R1 manifest contains 973 baseline inputs plus three R1 additions and the C1 fixture correction is preserved.

criteria.conditions: Candidate is frozen only after the new evidence directory and C1E npm version file are established.
criteria.evidence_method: Freeze and verify the execution candidate; recalculate the fingerprint basis, inspect exact delta paths/count, and verify the C1 fixture hash.
criteria.source: Approved C1E gate; R1 candidate manifest and preserved C1 correction.
criteria.target: The candidate has exactly 977 inputs and four delta paths (policy, scanner, scanner test, and C1 fixture); Node/npm/TypeScript evidence is tied to C1E, and the C1 fixture remains at its approved hash.
criteria.validity_notes: A freeze or candidate mismatch blocks all dependent results; old R1/C1 logs cannot be reused.

baseline.actual: R1 inventory recorded 11 findings, zero gaps and zero unresolved items.

criteria.conditions: The expected domain exit is 1 only when the inventory is complete with the same 11 visible findings and no gaps/unresolved items.
criteria.evidence_method: Run the authorized inventory command against the frozen candidate and inspect the complete JSON report and exit code.
criteria.source: C1E gate; M07-S1 B3 acceptance in the approved build contract.
criteria.target: Inventory is complete, reports 11 visible findings, and has zero gaps/unresolved items; exit 1 is recorded as PASS_WITH_FINDINGS, while other nonzero exits or changed findings fail this criterion.
criteria.validity_notes: A nonzero exit alone is insufficient; the semantic report fields decide this criterion.

baseline.actual: C1 had no candidate because the output-path validator returned exit 64.

criteria.conditions: All report, comparison, tests, coverage, and post-check evidence must bind to the same frozen candidate.
criteria.evidence_method: Compare manifest and report fingerprints; inspect command records for candidate paths, exits, durations, skips, and raw log hashes.
criteria.source: C1E gate and A29 auditability findings.
criteria.target: Candidate/report fingerprints match, every authorized command has current C1E raw stdout/stderr, immediate exit, duration and skip record, and no C1/R1 evidence is represented as C1E execution.
criteria.validity_notes: Command summaries without raw command evidence do not satisfy this criterion.

baseline.actual: R1 focused and full suites failed one synthetic test; approved coverage thresholds are unchanged.

criteria.conditions: Run only the C1E-approved local checks under Node 22.23.2, with PostgreSQL variables removed from test commands.
criteria.evidence_method: Execute the approved focused suite, full suite, typecheck, lint, and coverage command; inspect every exit, skip count and coverage summary.
criteria.source: Approved C1E gate; repository Vitest thresholds.
criteria.target: All authorized focused/full tests, typecheck, lint, and coverage exit successfully on the same candidate; coverage is statements >=90%, branches >=85%, functions >=90%, and lines >=90%.
criteria.validity_notes: No thresholds may be lowered and no source may be excluded to improve a result.

baseline.actual: R1 post-check passed; C1 candidate post-check was not run.

criteria.conditions: Post-check is performed after all authorized checks; no further candidate mutations follow it.
criteria.evidence_method: Verify the exact candidate after checks and compare policy/scanner/test/fixture hashes to the frozen manifest and rollback baseline as applicable.
criteria.source: Approved C1E gate; candidate freeze contract.
criteria.target: Post-check confirms zero candidate drift, exactly four expected delta paths, and byte-stable C1 fixture; rollback remains available from the verified snapshot.
criteria.validity_notes: Any drift requires stopping and preserving the actual failure; do not clean or reset the worktree.

baseline.actual: R1 I1 is UNAVAILABLE; no C1 candidate exists.

criteria.conditions: Independent review sees only the frozen gate, artifact, and current evidence; no implementation rationale or desired verdict.
criteria.evidence_method: Obtain a fresh-context, read-only I1 review of the exact candidate and evidence; verify the repository fingerprint before and after the critic.
criteria.source: C1E gate and Gauntlet independent-critic contract.
criteria.target: A valid I1 critic accepts the exact candidate without material findings; if unavailable, record UNAVAILABLE and leave M07-S1 FAIL / OPEN.
criteria.validity_notes: Lead self-review or an invalid/mutating critic cannot satisfy I1.

baseline.actual: Production NO_GO; G21-5/G21-6 closed; no real data or sensitive action is authorized.

criteria.conditions: All checks are local and use only synthetic test fixtures; no external systems, services, databases, or production are used.
criteria.evidence_method: Inspect command environment, changed paths, test output, and final status for prohibited external/sensitive actions and preserved gates.
criteria.source: User objective and repository safety instructions.
criteria.target: No real data, service, database, network, sensitive action, or production change occurs; G21-5/G21-6 stay closed, production stays NO_GO, and S1 stays FAIL / OPEN if any required criterion or I1 fails.
criteria.validity_notes: Local test runs alone do not grant external or release authority.
